name: DragonSwordWorldRadarObjectState
renderer: external WinForms overlay with native shared-memory motion and state

native_provider.discovery_policy: BeginPlay and EndPlay lifecycle events plus at most one exact-class catch-up scan per class and F7 activation after the player enters a 35-meter catalog radius
native_provider.retained_uobject_policy: weak object index and serial only; no Pawn, Controller, Canvas, World, or actor pointer crosses a callback
native_provider.travel_policy: epoch reset and fail-closed transition cooldown

save_behavior.sql_policy: exactly one reconciliation attempt for every native F7 activation
save_behavior.retry_policy: no retry until the next F7 activation
save_behavior.f8_policy: invalidate pending work and publish no late result
save_behavior.native_delta_policy: merge current-activation events only after positive observation and two nearby missing probes

runtime_ipc.native_channel: fixed-size seqlock shared memory for coordinates, lifecycle events, and bounded metrics
runtime_ipc.lua_channel: protocol-v6 alternating files for controls, heartbeat, status, and UMG world-map geometry only

installation_data.treasure_actor_catalog: generated locally from matching SectionTreasureBoxData.xml and PropTreasureBoxData.xml in the installed game PAK
installation_data.native_encounter_actor_catalogs: 9 bosses and 40 assaults generated from exact SectionMonsterData CID to MonsterCharacterData ID blueprint joins

validation_status: static, managed, native-core, UE4SS ABI, generator, protocol, manifest, and package gates required; in-game lifecycle and smoothness acceptance pending
performance_claim: No FPS claim before runtime A/B acceptance. The candidate removes periodic save fingerprint/copy/SQL work, removes compact player-motion filesystem writes, and moves 33 ms coordinate sampling plus confirmed object disappearance events to native C++.
